experiment: CPM baseline vs kernel ensemble on the same target and folds
finding: Connectome-based predictive modelling — the method most clinical papers use — reaches 0.326 on this target, roughly half our kernel ensemble's 0.635. CPM's appeal is interpretability (it names a set of edges), not accuracy.
caveat: CPM hyperparameter is the correlation threshold (0.01 used here); a sweep could move its number, so report it as a baseline with the threshold stated.
